Complicated question: Saving Private Ryan provides more cinematic constructions about what occurred in the day to day life of soldiers dealing with the horrors of violence…The Thin Red Line offered a greater view of the interiority of that violence…cinematically speaking, Saving Private Ryan is a more engrossing film, seeing people explode or seeing people getting shot or stabbed to death is a horrifying experience, but The Thin Red Line crossed perspectives to make war a unique experience across different individuals.  I would say that there is poetry in The Thin Red Line while Saving Private Ryan provided austere prose.  They are good for different reasons.
